description: Runs one Calcupedia calculator with its verified formulas. Returns every result, a link that opens the calculator with the same values, and the inputs it accepts with their current values. Use it for finance, health, math, date and unit-conversion questions that need exact figures the user can check. Input keys differ per calculator and are listed by search_calculators; omitted inputs use the calculator's defaults.

inputs.description: Input values keyed by input key, for example {"home_price": 400000, "interest_rate": 6.5}.

slug.description: Calculator slug from search_calculators, for example "mortgage-calculator".

name: run_calculator
title: Run a calculator
